tasks.name: 创建博客模型
tasks.description: 创建 Blog 模型用于存储博客文章信息。在 app/models/ 目录下创建 blog.py，包含字段: id, title, content, image_url, created_at。

tasks.name: 创建图片上传功能
tasks.description: 实现图片上传功能。在 app/utils/ 下创建 image_upload.py，包含处理图片上传和存储的逻辑，支持文件类型验证和存储路径设置。

tasks.name: 创建博客API
tasks.description: 创建博客文章的 CRUD API 路由。在 app/routes/ 下创建 blogs.py，包含创建、读取、更新、删除博客文章的接口，并支持图片上传功能。

tasks.name: 创建博客前端页面
tasks.description: 创建博客管理的前端页面。在 templates/ 下创建 blog.html，包含博客文章的创建表单（支持图片上传）和文章列表展示。

tasks.name: 设置静态文件支持
tasks.description: 配置静态文件支持以存储上传的图片。在项目的 settings 或配置文件中设置静态文件路径，并确保前端可以访问上传的图片。

T1.implementation_approach: Define a Blog model with fields like title, content, author, and timestamp in the database schema.
T1.notes: Ensure proper validation and indexing for efficient querying.

T2.implementation_approach: Implement an image upload feature using a library like Cloudinary or local storage with file validation.
T2.notes: Set size and format restrictions for uploaded images.

T3.implementation_approach: Create RESTful API endpoints for CRUD operations on the Blog model using a framework like Django REST Framework or Flask.
T3.notes: Include authentication and pagination for better security and usability.

T4.implementation_approach: Develop a responsive frontend using a framework like React or Vue to display and interact with blog data.
T4.notes: Integrate the frontend with the API for dynamic content updates.

T5.implementation_approach: Configure the web server or framework to serve static files like CSS, JS, and images.
T5.notes: Use caching and compression to optimize static file delivery.
